items.title: Bley Carla — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: And Dave Brubeck, but I didn’t have a phonograph so I couldn’t buy records in those days.

ctx.x: How did you know of Cafe Bohemia? I mean what was....

I don’t know. The records I had heard while I was in California were... Teo Macero put out a record called What’s New? And on it was, I remember, uhh... Phil Woods, it was a jazz record but it was really weird. It had a lot of techno goings on, like recorded voices or chants from priests and... check out that record Teo Macero What’s New. Really interesting I loved that. And Dave Brubeck, but I didn’t have a phonograph so I couldn’t buy records in those days. I didn’t have a phonograph until I was maybe 22 years…
Was there much of a Loft scene happening right then?
